title: Giant cell tumor of bone（骨巨细胞瘤）

properties.disease overview: An intermediate (locally aggressive) bone tumor typically affecting young adults; commonly involves the epiphysis of long bones and can recur after treatment.
properties.mechanism: Locally aggressive osteolytic tumor characterized by multinucleated giant cells; causes expansile lytic lesion (‘soap-bubble’ appearance) and may lead to pain, swelling, and pathological fracture.
properties.disorder: Giant cell tumor of bone（骨巨细胞瘤）
